item.title: [Meeting] Lodging Tax Board 06/18/26 — 2026-06-18
item.description:
San Miguel County • 2026-06-18
The Lodging Tax Board meets to review tax reports and hear updates from the Norwood Chamber and Telluride Tourism Board. Standard quarterly check-in on how lodging tax dollars are being distributed and used across the county.

item.title: [Thu, Jun 18] Mountain Village Adventure Book Club
item.description: 🎫 Wilkinson Public Library 📍 San Sophia Station - Gondola 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM · Do you love books and love to hike? Want to go on an adventure? Let's do all of those things and meet in Mountain Village at the San Sophia Station with our water bottles. We will hike down to the core and get some snacks at Dolce.
